items.Sentence: The wastewater system is composed of sanitary sewer conveyance piping, 11 septic tanks, eight wastewater disposal field areas, an RV dump station, a lift station, one sand trap, and two grease traps.

The wastewater system is composed of sanitary sewer conveyance piping, 11 septic tanks, eight wastewater disposal field areas, an RV dump station, a lift station, one sand trap, and two grease traps.

Restaurant and wash station grease waste is collected in a 50-gallon grease trap. Grease trap effluent flows into the serving septic tank. The grease traps are pumped clean and disposed offsite regularly.
Septic tank sludge is removed by a certified sewage hauler and disposed of at wastewater treatment plant classified to receive biosolids and sludge.
